fall_fwd.why: 14 N does not topple this robot; scaled with mass (50 N at 4.4 kg) to the 4.6 kg XGT-battery robot. Clearly unrecoverable, as the scenario intends

fall_back.why: -12 N does not topple this robot; -35 N at 4.4 kg scaled with mass to 4.6 kg

fall_trip.why: 3 N m does not trip this robot; 7 N m at 4.4 kg scaled with mass to 4.6 kg

fast_turn.why: leans into the turn (wbc_carve): 9.4 deg at 1.4 m/s^2; roll vs the bank reference lags 3.2 deg on entry. Limit 1.5x, floor ~0.75x

extreme.why: wbc_carve: leans 17 deg, both wheels stay >=12.9 N; roll lags the bank reference 5.7 deg on entry. Limit 1.5x, floors ~0.65-0.75x

slalom.why: wbc_carve: lean reversals every 2 s (8 deg each way), roll lags 5 deg at each flip. Limit 1.5x, floor 0.75x

max_cmd.why: known_fail on CAD/; the BD droid carves it (22 deg lean, yaw_rmse 0.091, wheels >=10 N). Limits 1.5x, floors ~0.6-0.75x
